raw.details:
Overview:

ELEVATE 1.0 is a national-level hackathon organized by DJS NSDC, Dwarkadas J. Sanghvi College of Engineering, bringing together student innovators, developers, designers, and problem-solvers to build impactful solutions to real-world challenges.

Eligibility & Team Formation:

  • ELEVATE 1.0 is open to EVERYONE.
  • Inter-college and inter-specialization teams are allowed.
  • Each team must consist of 2–4 members.
  • Each participant can be part of only one team.

Hackathon Format:

ELEVATE 1.0 consists of 2 rounds, with different Problem Statements for each round.

ROUND 0 — Ideation & Screening:

Round 0 is the initial screening round conducted online through Unstop.

  • A set of Round 0 Problem Statements will be provided on the Unstop registration page.
  • Each team must select any one Problem Statement (Round 0 specific).
  • Teams must develop a solution idea/approach for their selected Problem Statement.
  • Teams must prepare their presentation using the official PPT template provided.
  • The completed PPT must be submitted through Unstop before the submission deadline.
  • Teams must pay the ₹200 initial registration fee to participate in Round 0.
  • The submissions will be evaluated and The Top 30 teams will be shortlisted for Round 1.

ROUND 1 — 24-Hour Hackathon:

The Top 30 shortlisted teams will be invited to Dwarkadas J. Sanghvi College of Engineering for the final round.

Round 1 will feature a new set of Problem Statements, different from those provided in Round 0.

The selected teams will participate in an intensive 24-hour offline hackathon, where they will:

  • Select and work on a New Round 1 Problem Statement.
  • Build a functional prototype/MVP addressing the selected challenge.
  • Implement and demonstrate their proposed solution.
  • Submit their final project and required deliverables within the designated hackathon timeline.
  • Present and demonstrate their solution before the final judging panel.

Shortlisted teams will be required to pay a ₹1,500 final-round participation fee to confirm their participation in the 24-hour hackathon.
